source: P3563 KartRider.exe PID 8424, read-only Frida hook of FUN_00B53F80
notes: The kart is already turning with raw +1 steer and +1.59 rad/s yaw when the trace starts. The drift key is released at that point.

kr_capture2.py records every tenth B53F80 substep. The third sample after the start already has raw -1, drift active and 0.198 s left on the 0.2 s trigger timer. On the Web 2 ms grid this places the Shift press at 30 × 2 ms − 2 ms = 58 ms. The native capture does not record any 1 ms remainder steps. Sample timestamps are still the captured wall-clock offsets.

Forward speed is the native +0xADC field. Lateral speed is reconstructed as sqrt(+0xAF0^2 - +0xADC^2); the sign follows the observed yaw/steer transition because the live +0xAE0 read returned zero in this build.
No player names or replay identifiers are stored.
